title: Committee of Adjustment - September 29, 2026
meeting_location: Ben Franklin Place, The Chamber, Main Floor, 101 Centrepointe Drive

agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER
agenda_items.minutes: The Committee met in Room 1C, Ben Franklin Place, 101 Centrepointe Drive, Ottawa, on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, beginning at 11:30 a.m. Vice-Chair Terry Otto presided over the meeting in person with the Members attending either in person or electronically.

agenda_items.title: ELECTION OF CHAIR
agenda_items.minutes:
The Secretary-Treasurer presided over the election and issued a call for nominations to the position of Committee Chair.         
MOTION
Moved by Member :             J. Baltz
Seconded by Member :       J. Wright
WHEREAS the Members must elect one of the Vice-Chairs as Committee Chair;
THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED that Vice-Chair Terry OTTO be elected Committee Chair.
 
                                                                                                                            CARRIED
